description: Calculates the Attribute Points (AP) an FC 27 Pro Clubs archetype needs to reach target attribute values from its starting stats, the first level that has that many AP (cap 55 = 1,419 AP), which Specializations the targets unlock, and a Build Planner link with the targets loaded.

level.description: Optional level to check the budget against (default 55).

targets.description: Attribute name to target value, e.g. {"Acceleration": 90, "Dribbling": 92}. Values above the cap are capped.

name: calculate_build_cost
title: Calculate AP for a build
